name: flight-tracker
examples_zh: 查询现在瑞士上空有哪些航班，并列出呼号、高度和速度。
帮我用呼号 SWR123 追踪这架飞机的实时位置。
查一下今天从 JFK 到 LHR 的航班时刻和可用航班信息。
examples_en: Show live flights currently over Switzerland with callsign, altitude, and speed.
Track callsign SWR123 and report its current OpenSky position.
Search today's flight schedule from JFK to LHR and list available flights.
description_zh: 实时航班追踪，支持按地区、呼号、机场查询航班动态与时刻
description_en: Real-time flight tracking and schedule search via OpenSky Network
